display.purpose: Welcome heading and large section headings; Cinzel Decorative.

title.purpose: Active tabs and major labels; Cinzel Decorative.

caption.purpose: Version block and muted values; Cinzel.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Text-only command with a thin rounded outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #3A3A3A; border-radius: 12dp; min-height: 48dp; padding: 12dp 24dp; font: 400 18sp Cinzel, serif; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2dp; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { color: #8A8A8A; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Credential field with a thin outline and no fill.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #3A3A3A; border-radius: 12dp; min-height: 56dp; padding: 12dp 16dp; font: 400 18sp Cinzel, serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Sidebar Tab
components.description: Text-only navigation item; active state adds the outline.
components.css: .ds-tab-active { background: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #3A3A3A; border-radius: 12dp; min-height: 48dp; padding: 12dp 24dp; font: 700 18sp Cinzel, serif; } .ds-tab-inactive { background: #000000; color: #8A8A8A; border: none; font: 400 18sp Cinzel, serif; }

components.name: Settings Row
components.description: Label on the left, outlined action on the right.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16dp 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #3A3A3A; color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 18sp Cinzel, serif; }

components.name: Version Block
components.description: Real app and client version, never the Figma mock value.

narrative.overview: An exact visual reproduction of the five user-supplied Figma screens. Monochrome, high-contrast serif, thin grey outlines, no icons, no colour accent. Real build and device values replace the static numbers in the mockup.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black, white and two greys
Cinzel for all text and Cinzel Decorative for headings
Real device and build values only

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system is coloured; state is weight, case, opacity and outline.

rules.name: The All-Cinzel Rule
rules.body: No second family and no icon font appears on these surfaces.

dos: Do reproduce the five Figma screens literally in composition and type.
Do use real version and client values.
Do keep every control at least 48dp high on touch devices.
donts: Don't add colours, icons, gradients, shadows or filled buttons.
Don't invent FPS, online counts or driver names.
